title: Responsible AI for Test Equity and Quality: The Duolingo English Test as a Case Study

bias_targets.methodology: Differential Rater Functioning (DRF) and Differential Item Functioning (DIF) analyses on AI scoring models and item banks to quantify and detect differential performance across male and female test-takers.

Differential Rater Functioning (DRF) and Differential Item Functioning (DIF) analyses to detect bias by comparing model performance and item difficulty across test-takers with different self-reported first language (L1) backgrounds.

Human-in-the-loop Fairness and Bias (FAB) reviews of automatically generated content to identify and remove culturally sensitive, upsetting, or inaccessible topics that introduce construct-irrelevant variance.
